messages:
Jordan: Quick note — noticed inconsistency in docs reference for /v1/generate. Examples use max_tokens but API implementation expects max_output_tokens. This causes SDK examples to break in integration tests. Can someone pick up a docs PR?

Priya: Hmm, where exactly? I searched repo — found docs/reference/generate.md and the python/js SDK snippets. I'll open a PR to unify to max_output_tokens and add alias handling.

Sam: @Priya please also update the request/response schema table under docs/reference/endpoints.md. CI has schema tests that will catch mismatches. Also add a short note about the deprecated alias so users migrating aren't surprised.

Marta: Also the example response in generate.md omits "finish_reason" and shows "id" as a number vs a string. That's failing client deserialization in the dotnet SDK integration tests.

Priya: Good catch Marta — I'll change id -> string and add finish_reason. For backward compatibility, we can accept numeric ids server-side for a release but docs should show the canonical string form.

Jordan: Thanks. Can we also update curl + SDK snippets? Example for python should show:
```
resp = client.generate(model="m1", input="hi", max_output_tokens=128)
```
And js:
```
client.generate({model: 'm1', input: 'hi', max_output_tokens: 128})
```

Sam: Add a short migration note in docs/breaking-changes.md and link it from the API ref. Also include a one-liner in the changelog so customers see it in release notes.

Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — includes changes to generate.md, endpoints schema, and python/js snippets. Running local schema tests now.

docs-bot: lint results: 3 warnings, 0 errors — docs/style: prefer "max_output_tokens" over "max_tokens". See CI details: https://ci.redwood/12345

Marta: Reviewed quick pass, left an inline comment about example output formatting and JSON indentation. @Jordan I'll merge once tests pass and Priya addresses my comment.

Jordan: :thumbsup: Thanks all. If anyone spots other endpoints using the old param name, please drop the file path here and we'll bundle fixes into the same PR.
